gravewright-pdf-system.hint.tokenSize: GM only. Sets how many grid squares the token occupies on each side when placed on the board.
gravewright-pdf-system.hint.bars: Pick which PDF field feeds each token value. The chosen field writes straight to it.
gravewright-pdf-system.hint.barsNeedPdf: Open a PDF with form fields first.
gravewright-pdf-system.hint.textColor: The fields sit on the PDF page, which is light: dark text reads best. Change it for dark or coloured sheets.
gravewright-pdf-system.hint.tokenName: Uses the same name as the sheet and updates linked representations on the board.
gravewright-pdf-system.hint.tokenImage: Shown on the board. Falls back to the portrait when unset.
gravewright-pdf-system.settings.defaultT: Template used by new characters. Leave blank to choose per character.
gravewright-pdf-system.settings.showFiel: Draws Gravewright's own inputs over the PDF fields. Turn off to read the page without editing.
gravewright-pdf-system.ui.noFieldsWithou: Fields of an uploaded PDF need the renderer.
gravewright-pdf-system.ui.noPdfsYet: No PDF available. Upload one to the campaign's asset library.
gravewright-pdf-system.ui.noTemplate: No PDF chosen yet. Use the PDF button to pick or upload one.
gravewright-pdf-system.ui.noViewer: No PDF renderer is installed. The sheet data still works, but the page cannot be shown.
gravewright-pdf-system.ui.openFailed: Could not open the PDF. The sheet data still works.
